description.tr: Bilimsel çevirinin ilk Müslüman hamisi — Beytü'l-Hikme'den bir yüzyıldan fazla önce Yunanca ve Kıptîce simya metinlerini Arapçaya çevirtmeyi sipariş ederek çeviri hareketini ateşledi || Hâlid, siyasi hırsı bilim için terk eden bir Emevi prensiydi. || [Tarih notu] Hâlid'in simya hamiliğinin tarihselliği tartışmalıdır ama Ullmann (1972) ve Sezgin (GAS IV) tarafından kabul edilmiştir.
description.en: First Muslim patron of scientific translation — commissioned Greek and Coptic alchemical texts into Arabic over a century before the House of Wisdom, igniting the translation movement || Khalid was an Umayyad prince who renounced political ambition for scholarship. Source material identifies him as commissioning the first Arabic alchemical translations from Greek and Coptic. The Jabirian corpus later credited him as a foundational figure. His patronage demonstrates that the translation movement predated the Abbasids. || [Historiographical note] The historicity of Khalid's alchemical patronage was debated by Ruska (1924) but largely accepted by Ullmann (1972) and Sezgin (GAS IV).
description.ar: أول راعٍ مسلم للترجمة العلمية — أمر بترجمة نصوص الخيمياء قبل بيت الحكمة بأكثر من قرن || كان خالد أميرًا أمويًا تخلى عن الطموح السياسي لصالح العلم. أمر بأول ترجمات عربية للخيمياء من اليونانية والقبطية
